'''Egon Matijevic''' (27 April 1922 – 20 July 2016) was an American [[chemist]]. He earned his [[B.Sc.]] and [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in [[chemistry]] from the [[University of Zagreb]]. After specialization at the [[University of Cambridge]] he continued to work at the [[Clarkson University]]. He is the author of more than 550 scientific papers in [[colloidal chemistry|colloidal]] and [[surface science|surface chemistry]] with numerous applications in [[medicine]] and [[Industrial sector|industry]]. Matijevic was a member of [[American Chemical Society]], American Association for Crystal Growth, World Academy of Ceramics, International Association of Colloid and Interface Scientists and honorary member of [[American Ceramic Society]], German Colloid Society, [[Chemical Society of Japan]] and Materials Research Society of Japan.<ref name="CAMP"/><ref name="NCNow"/><ref name="Cambridge"/><ref>{{cite journal| author=N. Kallay | title=Egon Matijević, his personality and achievements | journal=J Colloid Interface Sci | year=2013 | volume=15 | pages=1–6 | doi=10.1016/j.jcis.2012.09.061}}</ref><ref>{{cite news | title=A Tribute To Egon Matijević | year=2009 |publisher=[[American Chemical Society|ACS]] Chemical & Engineering News | volume=87 | issue=10 | page=2}}</ref>
